class.name: VoxelLightingData
class.brief_description: Saved world-space starting lighting for Voxel Forward DDGI.
class.description: Created by [VoxelLightingBake3D]. Stores versioned irradiance and visibility samples with stable world-space probe identities. Invalid data falls back to dynamic lighting.

method.name: get_probe_count
method.description: Returns the number of stored probe records.

method.name: validate
method.description: Returns an empty string for valid data, or a diagnostic describing an unsupported or corrupt cache.
